rows.en: Mechanic A: "We're behind schedule!"
Mechanic C: "Y-Yes! Whoa, aaaah!"
Mechanic D: "A-Are you all right?!"
Celica: "Phew... I nearly ended up as mincemeat..."
Mechanic C: "I-I'm sorry!"
Mechanic A: "You idiot! Of all people, the chief..."
Celica: "It's fine. I'm not hurt,
and it wasn't on purpose."
Mechanic D: "Oh! What a generous heart!
I am utterly overwhelmed with emotion!"
Celica: "No, you really don't need to be that moved..."
Yamato: "Oh, they're hard at work."
Touya: "How's it going?"
Celica: "Oh, well, not bad, I guess..."
Yamato: "Huh? Aren't you looking a little pale?"
Celica: "Y-Yeah... I was up all night working on Rayblade's
final adjustments..."
Touya: "Hey, are you all right?"
Mechanic F: "I couldn't go that far even for my own boyfriend.
Still, thanks to that, apart from the systems,
the adjustments are almost finished.
Chief, the phrase 'not even sparing time to sleep'
really was made for you."
Celica: "H-Hey..."
Touya: "I see... Thanks, Celica."
Celica: "Huh? Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "But don't push yourself too hard.
If you collapse, there won't be anyone left
I can trust to handle this."
Celica: "Huh?"
Mechanic F: "That's how much he trusts you, Chief.
And that trust will eventually blossom into burning love...
Oh, it sounds so wonderful!"
Celica: "Hey! Wh-What are you talking about?!"
Mechanic F: "Huh?
It's written all over your face that you don't mind the idea."
Celica: "Oh, come on! It's nothing like that.
Right, Touya...?"
Touya: "I see... So it'll finally be fixed..."
Yamato: "Looking at it like this, I get a sense of 'majesty'
or something..."
Mechanic F: "...He's not listening at all."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "Hmm? What?"
Celica: "Nothing!"
Touya: "What are you mad about?"
Celica: "I've still got work to do!
Come on, move! Out of the way!"
Bernst: "My, my. Someone's in a bad mood.
And this is about to move again too."
Celica: "Of course it's nothing like that."
Mechanic F: "Oh? Really? I was sure..."
Celica: "No, no. Right, Touya?"
Touya: "I see... So it'll finally be fixed..."
Yamato: "Looking at it like this, I get a sense of 'majesty'
or something..."
Mechanic F: "...He's not listening at all."
Celica: "...So it seems."
Touya: "Hmm? Did you say something?"
Celica: "N-No, nothing.
Anyway, leave Rayblade to us.
We'll get it in perfect shape."
Bernst: "It's truly magnificent.
Perhaps..."
Celica: "Oh..."
Touya: "What are you doing here?"
Celica: "He's been helping me with the repairs too."
Touya: "Huh. So you're part of the reason we could get it repaired
in such a short time?"
Bernst: "No, no. It's all thanks to Princess Celica.
I merely offered advice."
Celica: "Yes. Advice so accurate it was frightening."
Bernst: "I'm honored.
Perhaps I have a knack
for this sort of thing."
Celica: "You make it sound like you've never been involved before."
Bernst: "Heh heh heh..."
Touya: "You... Just who are you?"
Bernst: "Heh heh heh. Who indeed?
Perhaps I'm a ghost who doesn't exist here."
Maki: "Hey, can Rayblade move now?"
Celica: "Almost. We just need to adjust the control systems."
Maki: "Aw. I thought I could catch the moment it starts up
on camera..."
Touya: "...You're dedicated to your work."
Maki: "Of course. 'The Demon of a Hundred Years Ago Returns?!
The Tragedy Strikes Again!'"
Touya: "What the hell's that?"
Maki: "A headline, a headline. Pretty good, isn't it?"
Touya: "...It sounds like some cheap tabloid story."
Maki: "...What's that?"
Celica: "Apparently, it's an article that blows celebrity rumors out of proportion
until they're barely distinguishable from lies, or just plain false."
Maki: "H-How rude! You can only keep saying that
for now. There must have been a reason why Rayblade
was sealed away in the first place.
And it fought on equal terms with ≪Ze=Ode≫.
There's definitely something there."
Bernst: "What exactly do you mean by 'something'?"
Maki: "Hmm, for example, maybe Rayblade itself
was the cause of that tragedy.
As for Rayblade single-handedly taking on ≪Ze=Ode≫,
that's what some people say,
but then I wonder why it was sealed away."
Touya: "Wasn't it to keep it from being used as a weapon?"
Maki: "That's just what the people of the Holy Land say, isn't it?
You'll never see the truth
if you swallow everything people tell you."
Bernst: "You have a point.
You can't know anything for sure
until you've seen for yourself."
Maki: "Huh, you understand.
You're... Mr. Bernst, right?"
Bernst: "Yes... Is something wrong?"
Maki: "Hmm, I feel like I've heard your name
somewhere before..."
Bernst: "Have we met before?"
Maki: "No. This is our first meeting.
I never forget the face or name of anyone I've met.
But... Hmm... No, I can't place it. That's strange..."
Bernst: "..."
Maki: "Oh, well.
I'll get some footage of Rayblade for now.
Reisuke... Huh? He's gone..."
Bernst: "Celica just carried Reisuke
farther inside."
Maki: "What?! ...Oh, come on!"
Bernst: "...Well, now that things with Rayblade have settled down,
it seems my work here is done too."
Touya: "...? There's something strange about the way you said that."
Bernst: "I mean exactly what I said.
One of my reasons for being here has simply disappeared.
The rest is up to you, Touya.
Although it seems you'll be fine
without my saying anything."
Touya: "What's that supposed to mean?"
Bernst: "For now, I want you to grow stronger.
...Strong enough to defeat ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Touya: "Weren't you hoping for a way
other than fighting?"
Bernst: "Even if that's what we hope,
they'll try to crush us with force.
It's so we can resist that.
People are creatures who find it hard
to admit their own mistakes. We've reached a point where fighting
is necessary to make them recognize those mistakes."
Touya: "I don't like you deciding that for everyone, but yeah,
we'll probably end up fighting. Still,
just what are you planning to do?"
Bernst: "That... Is a secret."
Touya: "Oh, come on..."
Bernst: "You'll understand in time.
That I am not your enemy
is the one thing you can be sure of."
Touya: "It sounds like you're saying you're not our ally either."
Bernst: "My, you really are interesting.
Let's see... Even if I said I was your ally,
you'd eventually stop seeing me that way."
Touya: "A prophecy this time?"
Bernst: "Yes. I think it's quite likely to come true.
In any case, solving the problem in front of us
should take priority now.
Isn't the Zigrim army about to come
to retake this place?"
Touya: "Are you going to dodge the question again?"
Bernst: "Heh heh heh... Well, if you'll excuse me."
Touya: "H-Hey!"
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan! It's terrible!"
Yamato: "What happened?"
Kasumi: "A whole lot of Armored Mechs have appeared outside the castle!"
Touya: "What?!"
Fain: "Hey, they still had that many left...?"
Garyud: "The troops stationed at Belnea Fort and the border
must have been gathered as well."
Reduce: "That was quick."
Garyud: "With Grad Burgley's skill,
something like this would be effortless.
He has more the makings of a general than a knight."
Ciel: "You... Expected this?"
Garyud: "Yes. But if we win this battle,
victory will be ours."
Ymir: "Lord Garyud, surely you didn't... Plan for this?"
Garyud: "Guerrilla tactics would give us better odds,
but prolong the fighting. Then the Zigrim army
would start taking food from the local area.
If they did that before harvest season,
even if we won, what awaited us afterward would be starvation.
Even with the efforts of Prince Lodis and Lady Ivel of the Holy Land,
we could not escape that."
Ymir: "But that's far too dangerous a gamble..."
Ciel: "!? Father's judgment is correct.
Simply winning isn't enough for us.
We have to think about what happens afterward too.
...Do you have any combat experience?"
Ymir: "...Only since I came aboard Liebhofen."
Ciel: "I thought so. I don't want an amateur who doesn't even fight in an Armored Mech
butting in!"
Ymir: "I-I'm sorry..."
Garyud: "Ciel, that's quite enough.
Miss Ymir, I apologize. My daughter is nervous
before the battle. Please forgive her."
Ymir: "Y-Yes."
Ciel: "Father?!"
Reduce: "This is no time to argue.
We must decide how to deal with the enemy before us.
If you're a knight, you should at least understand that."
Ciel: "...I-I understand!
Then I shall prepare for my duty as a knight
and get Almaris ready to sortie!"
Garyud: "Good grief... Forgive my strong-willed daughter."
Ymir: "No... It shows how deeply she admires you, Lord Garyud.
I'm envious."
Garyud: "Heh heh heh..."
Reduce: "Lord Garyud, perhaps it's time to explain the operation..."
Garyud: "Yes, quite right.
As you can see, the enemy is quite numerous.
A frontal battle would be unwise. But a siege
would be even more dangerous. So we'll use a secret passage
to ambush the supply train that should be to their rear.
We'll throw them into confusion and strike their headquarters from both sides."
Ymir: "We'll split into two groups for this operation.
We'd be at a disadvantage if they overwhelm us with numbers."
Arthur: "Cutting off their supplies
would certainly cause confusion, but wouldn't their numerical strength
itself remain unchanged?"
Garyud: "Zigrim's strength lies in its firm chain of command.
Break that, and they will crumble easily."
Ai: "I see. It's just like Okehazama."
Touya: "Oh, you know about that?"
Ai: "...You think I'm an idiot, don't you?"
Ymir: "In any case, they'll be on guard,
but we shouldn't give them any unnecessary clues.
The 'Headquarters Assault Unit' will defend until the ambush succeeds,
so it'll be small. Lord Garyud,
Reduce, Clovis and Arthur, I'm asking you to handle it.
For the 'Supply Train Ambush Unit,'
we'll have Ciel as our guide, along with Ai, Aurelie,
Xiujian, Fain and Celica.
That will be the team. Does anyone object?"
Fain: "Y-Ymir! This battle will be dangerous.
If anything should happen to the princess..."
Celica: "That doesn't matter! If I just stay behind and watch,
then even if we liberate York,
people will still say the royals stayed somewhere safe and did nothing.
This concerns the dignity of not just me and Father, but the Mestina royal family
itself, you know?!
Are you saying you don't care if the royal family
becomes a laughingstock to the surrounding countries?!"
Fain: "Th-That's..."
Celica: "And I want to act of my own free will
to put things right. So, please."
Fain: "Ugh... V-Very well.
But you must escape if things get dangerous.
That's my condition."
Celica: "That's our Fain.
I knew you'd understand."
Ymir: "That just leaves Touya..."
Kasumi: "U-Um..."
Ymir: "What is it?"
Kasumi: "Please, let me help too."
Yamato: "What?!"
Kasumi: "I think even I can be of some help.
Besides, everyone's working so hard. I can't be the only one
who just watches."
Touya: "It's too dangerous!
Besides, you can't even pilot a mech, can you?"
Ai: "Kasumi's piloting is pretty good.
Maybe she's got more talent than you."
Touya: "Huh? How can you say that?"
Ai: "Because she's been practicing all this time.
And above all, yours truly, Ai, was her personal coach.
I trained her thoroughly."
Touya: "Huh? Really?"
Kasumi: "Yeah. I was going to ask you, Touya-chan,
but Ai-chan offered to teach me."
Ai: "So, what Kasumi needs now
is experience. This battle's a little intense, but if she's careful,
she'll be fine. I'll back her up too."
Aurelie: "I'm for it too.
She seems serious about this."
Clovis: "Huh. Wasn't she just dead weight?"
Aurelie: "When you see her practicing even when she should be asleep,
you've got to think a little better of her, or people might question
what kind of person you are."
Clovis: "That's true."
Kasumi: "Please, Touya-chan... Can't I?"
All right. But don't push yourself.
That's for Kasumi herself to decide.
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... Yeah."
Kasumi: "...Y-You're right. It's my decision, isn't it...?
I haven't changed my mind. Please let me help."
Ymir: "...Kasumi. I appreciate how you feel,
but it's still too dangerous.
We probably won't have the leeway to support you,
but we couldn't just leave you unsupported either.
So please stay aboard Liebhofen this time."
Kasumi: "...Yes, I understand."
Ai: "Kasumi..."
Kasumi: "It can't be helped. There's no point if I just get in the way..."
Ymir: "Now, Touya, as for you,
I'd like you to join the ambush unit if possible. Is that all right?"
Yeah, got it. (Supply Train Ambush Unit)
No, put me in the assault unit. (Headquarters Assault Unit)
Tell me the team assignments again.
Ymir: "Thank you. I'm counting on you, then."
Ymir: "Yes. Let's see...
The 'Headquarters Assault Unit' is Lord Garyud, Reduce,
Clovis and Arthur.
The 'Supply Train Ambush Unit'
is Ciel, Ai, Aurelie, Xiujian,
Fain and Celica. That's the arrangement."
Ymir: "R-Really? But..."
Touya: "The ambush unit's fine with the people it has now.
Besides, even if we're just defending, that's their main force, right?
We could use a few more people."
Ai: "Exactly. We can handle things just fine ourselves.
Leave it to your true leader, Ai!"
Fain: "Who decided that, and when?"
Ai: "I did, just now!"
Touya: "Xiujian, I'm counting on you."
Xiujian: "Yes. Understood."
Ai: "Aaargh! That pisses me off!"
Fain: "Never mind her, but ignoring me
is the height of rudeness!"
Ai: "What do you mean, 'her'?!"
Fain: "I merely used the appropriate word."
Ai: "Grrrr!"
Fain: "Grrrrrr!"
Yamato: "They're two of a kind."
Ymir: "W-Well, it seems they'll be fine.
...I'm counting on you, then, Touya."
Touya: "Yeah."
Maki: "Hey, Rayblade can move now, right?
Aren't you sending it out?"
Ai: "Oh, come to think of it, yeah. Why not?"
Fain: "Are you an idiot? We can't commit Rayblade
to a battle like this, can we?"
Ai: "You just have to piss me off every time, don't you? Why not?!"
Fain: "..."
Fain: "...Why can't we?"
Ai: "Hey!"
Arthur: "...Even if it's for a just cause, if we use Rayblade
for one particular country, the other countries that accept it for fighting ≪Ze=Ode≫
as our trump card, and reluctantly at that, won't stay silent.
Especially the Kingdom of Agarthia."
Celica: "Well, even if that happened,
I think my brother and the others would handle it somehow,
but there's another reason we can't send it out."
Touya: "What?"
Celica: "I've got the activation key here, and I have no intention
of activating it. The adjustments aren't finished yet.
So, that's how it is. Give it up."
Maki: "I see... That's a shame.
But I'll film a 'Record of the York War of Independence'
here, so that's fine. Heh heh heh...
This year's Roguewar Prize is as good as mine..."
Touya: "What's this Roguewar Prize, anyway?"
Yamato: "It's something like the Pulitzer Prize
in our world."
Touya: "Huh."
Yamato: "Oh, you don't knyow what that is, do you?"
Touya: "..."
Maki: "Well, there you have it. Good luck, everyone!"
